text: Prime Minister P.V. Nada Simharao and Finance Minister Manmohan Singh opened the economy.
Lower taxes on imports, private companies welcome, foreign investment allowed.
Software companies in Bengaluru and Hyderabad began serving the whole world.
In 2014, India reached Mars on its very first try.
Why? The mission cost about $74 million. Less than the Hollywood space film Gravity. Cheaper
than a movie about space. Actually in space.
In 2023, Chandrayaan-3 became the first spacecraft to land near the moon's south pole. That
same year, India became the most populous country on Earth.
Narendra Modi has been Prime Minister since 2014. His supporters point to new roads and
airports, digital payments used by hundreds of millions, and fast growth. His critics
worry about jobs, inequality, and pressure on the press and on religious minorities.
And today, India is the world's fifth largest economy in dollars. The IMF expects it to
past Japan in 2027. Measured by what money can actually buy, it's already third.
